name: playmark
description: Playtest feedback from inside your Godot or Unity game, straight to Claude Code or Codex.

plugins.name: playmark
plugins.description: Mark what you see while playing your Godot or Unity game, write a note, and hand it to Claude Code or Codex: the frame, the last seconds of play, the log and the code under your pin. Fixes show up in the game. /playmark:new starts a blank game with it built in.
